messages.content: I'm trying to log into my account, but I can't remember if I have 'remember me' enabled. My password is 'correcthorsebatterystaple'.

function.name: user_authentication_login
function.description: Authenticates a user based on their username and password. It returns an authentication token if credentials are valid. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

remember_me.description: Whether to keep the user logged in for an extended period.

login_attempts.description: The number of unsuccessful login attempts before displaying a captcha.

message.content: Sure! To help you log in, could you please let me know your username? Once I have that, I can attempt to authenticate you with the password you provided. If you’d like, I can also set the “remember me” option so you don’t have to re-enter your credentials next time.
message.reasoning: The user wants to log in. They provide username? They didn't give username. They only gave password. We need username. Also we should not ask for password again. We can ask for username. Also mention we cannot proceed without username. Also we can ask if they want to enable remember me. But we don't know if they had it enabled. So we can ask them. Let's ask for username.
